demo_out=[[0,6,0,6,7,0,6,0,6,7,0,6,0,6],[0,0,0,0,7,0,0,0,0,7,0,0,0,0],[9,0,6,0,7,9,0,6,0,7,9,0,6,0],[6,9,0,6,7,6,9,0,6,7,6,9,0,6],[0,0,0,0,7,0,0,0,0,7,0,0,0,0],[9,0,9,0,7,9,0,9,0,7,9,0,9,0],[0,9,0,0,7,0,9,0,0,7,0,9,0,0],[0,0,6,0,7,0,0,6,0,7,0,0,6,0]]
def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    colors=[v for row in grid for v in row]
    # The separator is the color forming complete rows and/or columns.
    candidates=set(v for v in colors if all(x==v for x in grid[0]) or all(grid[r][0]==v for r in range(h)))
    sep=next((v for v in candidates if any(all(x==v for x in row) for row in grid) or any(all(grid[r][c]==v for r in range(h)) for c in range(w))),None)
    row_lines=[r for r in range(h) if sep is not None and all(v==sep for v in grid[r])]
    col_lines=[c for c in range(w) if sep is not None and all(grid[r][c]==sep for r in range(h))]
    row_stride=row_lines[1]-row_lines[0] if len(row_lines)>1 else (row_lines[0]+1 if row_lines else h)
    col_stride=col_lines[1]-col_lines[0] if len(col_lines)>1 else (col_lines[0]+1 if col_lines else w)
    row_starts=[0]+[x+1 for x in row_lines]
    col_starts=[0]+[x+1 for x in col_lines]
    row_starts=[x for x in row_starts if x<h]
    col_starts=[x for x in col_starts if x<w]
    nonsep=[v for row in grid for v in row if v!=sep]
    bg=max(set(nonsep),key=nonsep.count) if nonsep else 0
    best=(row_starts[0],col_starts[0]); bestscore=-1
    for rs in row_starts:
      for cs in col_starts:
        rh=min(row_stride,h-rs); cw=min(col_stride,w-cs)
        score=sum(grid[r][c]!=bg and grid[r][c]!=sep for r in range(rs,rs+rh) for c in range(cs,cs+cw))
        if score>bestscore: bestscore=score; best=(rs,cs)
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h):
      for c in range(w):
        if r in row_lines or c in col_lines: continue
        sr=(best[0]+(r%row_stride)) if row_lines else r
        sc=(best[1]+(c%col_stride)) if col_lines else c
        if sr<h and sc<w: out[r][c]=grid[sr][sc]
    return out
print('demo reproduces',transform(demo_in)==demo_out)
print(transform(grid))
